'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Killing of journalists in the Gaza war]]
***[[2025 Nasser Hospital strikes]]
****[[Double tap strike|Four]] [[Israeli Defence Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike|airstrikes]] against [[Nasser Hospital]] in [[Khan Yunis]], [[Palestine]], kill 22 people, including five journalists working for [[Reuters]] and [[Associated Press|AP]], according to Palestinian authorities. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-25/israel-airstrike-nasser-hospital-southern-gaza-kills-journalists/105696068 (ABC News Australia)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/08/25/nx-s1-5515630/israel-gaza-journalists-killed-hospital (NPR)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/25/israel-attack-gaza-hospital-may-constitute-war-on-many-fronts (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cly6lxn1l4po (BBC News)]
***Hassan Douhan, a journalist for newspaper ''[[Al-Hayat Al-Jadida]]'', is fatally shot by Israeli forces in the [[Al-Mawasi, Rafah|Al-Mawasi]] area of [[Khan Yunis]], [[Palestine]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/another-palestinian-journalist-killed-by-israeli-army-fire-in-gaza-death-toll-rises-to-246/3668937 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**Multiple [[Mail|postal organizations]] such as [[Australia Post]] and [[Japan Post Service|Japan Post]] announce a temporary suspension of shipments to the [[United States]] in response to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Donald Trump's]] [[executive order]] suspending the [[de minimis]] exemption. [https://www.reuters.com/en/japan-post-suspends-some-us-bound-mail-after-us-ends-duty-exemption-2025-08-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-26/australia-post-commercial-shipping-suspension-us-tariffs/105696336 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The [[Vietnamese government]] closes all schools and airports in the [[North Central Coast]] and orders 600,000 people to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] as [[2025 Pacific typhoon season#Typhoon Kajiki (Isang)|Typhoon Kajiki]] makes landfall in the [[Hà Tĩnh province|Hà Tĩnh]] and [[Quảng Bình province]]s, killing four people and injuring thirteen others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy0kqgxwwlo (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/tifon-vietnam-laos-tailandia-kajiki-663260dda51822b33c9006af8bfa7f16 (AP <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*[[2025 Isle of Wight helicopter crash]]
**Three people are killed and another is seriously injured when a [[Robinson R44]] helicopter crashes into the ground during a flying lesson near [[Shanklin]] on the [[Isle of Wight]], England. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c87e22ryerlo (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 Botswana medical crisis]]
**[[Botswana]] [[President of Botswana|president]] [[Duma Boko]] declares a public health emergency after the [[Health in Botswana|national medical supply chain]] collapses, ordering the [[Botswana Defence Force|military]] to manage emergency distribution while the [[Government of Botswana|government]] allocates [[Botswana pula|P]]250 million (US$18.6 million) in funding to address nationwide shortages of medical supplies. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/botswana-declares-public-health-emergency-clinics-run-out-medicine-2025-08-25/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh]]
**[[Chief Adviser of Bangladesh|Bangladeshi chief adviser]] [[Muhammad Yunus]] declares that [[Bangladesh|the country]] cannot allocate additional domestic resources to support its 1.3 million [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] refugees and urges the international community to create a sustainable plan for their repatriation to [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-runs-out-resources-rohingya-refugees-2025-08-25/ (Reuters)]

Johnson]]'' and ''[[United States v. Eichman]]'', the former the order acknowledges. **Former [[Mexico|Mexican]] [[drug lord]] and [[Sinaloa Cartel]] top leader [[Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada]] pleads guilty to [[Illegal drug trade in the United States|drug trafficking]] charges in the [[United States]].
